verdict: Veyran {1}{U}{R} can double triggered abilities of PERMANENTS caused by casting or copying instants/sorceries. Ten CURRENT Abaddon permanent abilities can benefit in the specified conditions, versus Harmonic {1}{R} doubling four current Shaman/Wizard engines on broader noncreature casts. Neither doubles Abaddon's static cascade grant or the cascade triggered ability on a spell. Potential synergy is broad but is NOT a win-rate or final selection claim.

source_negative_rules: Veyran does NOT double Abaddon's static cascade grant or cascade triggers on a spell.
Veyran does NOT double Wild-Magic Sorcerer's first exiled spell cascade grant; the triggered cascade lives on a spell, not the creature.
An instant/sorcery spell COPY is not a CAST. Birgi, Kessig, Thermo, Vivi, Keeper, Lost, Prosper, Passionate, Nalfeshnee do NOT trigger only from a COPY event; Storm-Kiln and Veyran Magecraft DO.
Veyran does not double Ignus CREATURE-cast loop, Impact Tremors' ordinary ETB trigger, Prosper's end-step exile, or cast events for non-instant/sorcery card types.
Veyran's three mana including blue/red and survival on board may be worse than two-mana Harmonic or preserved Nightscape Familiar discount in adverse short games.

finite_cast_from_exile_scenario.condition: Actual one-mana Brainstorm from EXILE, with Veyran, Birgi, Keeper, Lost, Nalfeshnee, Prosper, Storm-Kiln, Abaddon and Passionate Archaeologist already controlled. This is an optimistic very-many-permanents scenario, not an opening-hand claim. No opponent interferes in trace.
deterministic_events: Birgi produces two separate {R} triggers on the real cast.
Keeper deals Brainstorm MV1 damage twice; Abaddon's Passionate-granted damage triggers twice.
Lost creates two Spawn tokens; Prosper makes two Treasures (both source-triggered by the real exile cast).
Nalfeshnee generates two Brainstorm copies; those are COPIES and not additional casts.
Storm-Kiln triggers twice on the original Brainstorm cast and twice on EACH of two Brainstorm copies = six Storm-Kiln Treasures, plus two Prosper Treasures if all resolve.
Copies do not trigger more Nalfeshnee/Prosper/Keeper/Birgi/Lost; priority, card draw, targets and opponent reactions still control actual turn results.

cut_opportunity_costs.cost: Blue/red spell generic discount including UBR commander and red/blue recursion; replacement Veyran is one more paid mana than Harmonic.
One-mana early blue card selection and MV1 cascade target; removed to add Impact while preserving protected identity.
Four-mana protected 40K opponent-library card theft, flexible spent mana and life loss on cast; deletion is a real thematic sacrifice.

material_judgments.reason: Ten specific existing permanent triggers on instant/sorc cast/copy, including four on-theme Warhammer/exile engines; paying 1UR and survival required.
Choose one creature type and pay four; cannot amplify the suite's enchantment and different creature types, nor Abaddon static cascade.
Cheaper and less event-restricted for four current Shaman/Wizard engines; no doubling of the other six non-Wizard/Shaman permanent triggers.
Impact converts existing Ignus/Birgi repeat cast to all-opponent ETB damage; must justify actual cut.
